mapper.select:
select m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, m.PORTFOLIO_TYPE portfolioType, m.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, m.VDATE, m.MDATE, m.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, y.IS_GUARANTEE isGuarantee, y.OPEN_TYPE openType, y.RAISE_TYPE raiseType, y.INVEST_NATURE investNature, n.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, x.OPEN_MODE openMode, m.RISK_ENABLED riskEnabled from PTL_PORTFOLIO m inner join PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO y on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=y.PORTFOLIO_ID left join REP_PROD_INFO x on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=x.PROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT n on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=n.FINPROD_ID
m.MDATE + 30 >to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd')
and m.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}

select m.FINPROD_ID finprodId, m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, m.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket from FIN_PRODUCT m
m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL and rtrim(m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID) <> '' and m.TRADE_MARKET IS NOT NULL and rtrim(m.TRADE_MARKET) <> ''
and m.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':' || m.TRADE_MARKET in
#{item}

select m.FINPROD_ID assetCode, m.VAL_DATE valDate, m.VALUATION valuation from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION m
m.VAL_DATE IN ( select max(VAL_DATE) from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where VAL_DATE <= #{valDate, jdbcType=DATE} and FINPROD_ID = m.FINPROD_ID
and FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
group by FINPROD_ID )

select m.BASIS_CYY basisCcy, m.QUOT_CYY quotCcy, m.CLOSE_PRICE exchargeVal from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE m
TRADE_DATE IN (select max(TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE where TRADE_DATE <= #{valDate, jdbcType=DATE} and EXCHARGE_CODE = m.EXCHARGE_CODE
and m.BASIS_CYY || ':' || m.QUOT_CYY || ':' || m.DATASOURCE_TYPE in
#{item}
group by EXCHARGE_CODE )

select CALENDAR_ID calendarId, CDATE , IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday from MST_HOLIDAY
CDATE>=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') and CDATE <=add_months(to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd'), 12)
and CALENDAR_ID in
#{item}

select EVENT_ID eventId,1 AS occupyType,AMOUNT,PRICE_AMT priceAmt,TRADE_NUM tradeNum from RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO union all select EVENT_ID eventId,2 AS occupyType,AMOUNT,PRICE_AMT priceAmt,TRADE_NUM tradeNum from RSK_OCCUPY_INFO
select EVENT_CODE eventCode,IS_CALC_INDICATOR isCalcIndicator, EVENT_NAME eventName,REMARK from RSK_EVENT

select EVENT_CODE eventCode, ITEM_CODE itemCode, GROUP_ID groupId, ITEM_ANO_NAME itemAnoName, MATCH_TYPE matchType, ITEM_VALUE itemValue, OFFSET_VAL offsetVal, OFFSET_TYPE offsetType, OFFSET_UNIT offsetUnit from RSK_EVENT_ITEM_RULE
select PARA_CODE paraCode, EVENT_CODE eventCode, PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity, REL_TYPE relType, REL_ITEM relItem, CUSTOM_VAL customVal from RSK_EVENT_PARA_REL

select m.PARA_CODE paraCode, n.PARA_NAME paraName, m.PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity, m.PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE paraDisplayType, m.CONTENT , m.REDIS_FIELD redisField, m.IS_FRESH_CAN_TRD isFreshCanTrd, n.IS_UP_REDIS isUpRedis, n.PARAM_DATA_TYPE paramDataType, n.IS_FORBID isForbid, '' institutionCode from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA n on m.PARA_CODE=n.PARA_CODE
m.PARA_GRANULARITY in ('01','02','03')
and m.PARA_CODE in
#{item}
union all select m.PARA_CODE,y.PARA_NAME paraName, m.INSTITUTION_CODE as PARA_GRANULARITY,'FIX' AS PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE,m.CONTENT,null as redisField ,'N' as isFreshCanTrd,'N' as isUpRedis,'String' as paramDataType, y.IS_FORBID isForbid ,m.INSTITUTION_CODE as institutionCode from RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE m inner join (select MAX(RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE.VALID_DATE) as VALID_DATE,PARA_CODE,INSTITUTION_CODE from RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE where RSK_ISUP_FIX_RECODE.VALID_DATE<=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') group by PARA_CODE,INSTITUTION_CODE) n on m.PARA_CODE=n.PARA_CODE and m.VALID_DATE=n.VALID_DATE and m.INSTITUTION_CODE=n.INSTITUTION_CODE inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA y on m.PARA_CODE=y.PARA_CODE
m.PARA_CODE in
#{item}

select IND_ID indId, IND_NAME indName, IND_TYPE indType, EXPR , SUP_TYPE supType, TIME_POINT timePoint, SUP_FREQUENCY supFrequency, SUP_DIRECTION supDirection, IS_EXCP_WHEN_DIV_ZERO isExcpWhenDivZero, WARN_COND warnCond, APPROVE_COND approveCond, FOUL_COND foulCond from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR
IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and TIME_POINT !='03'
and IND_ID in
#{item}

SELECT m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,y.PORTFOLIO_NAME ptlNameRedis, listagg ( n.PTL_BAG_ID, ',' ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.PTL_BAG_ID) AS portfolioBagId, listagg ( s.PTL_BAG_NAME, ',' )WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.PTL_BAG_ID) AS portfolioBagName from ( select distinct PORTFOLIO_ID from ( select PORTFOLIO_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR where PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{portfolioLevel} union all select PORTFOLIO_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL ) ) m left join RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL n on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=n.PORTFOLIO_ID left join RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE s on n.PTL_BAG_ID=s.PTL_BAG_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO y on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=y.PORTFOLIO_ID
m.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
group by m.PORTFOLIO_ID,y.PORTFOLIO_NAME

select m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,XMLAGG(xmlelement(E,m.IND_ID || ',')).extract('//text()').getclobval() as ptlIndicatorId, m.PORTFOLIO_NAME ptlNameRedis from ( select x.IND_ID,x.PORTFOLIO_ID ,x.START_DATE,x.END_DATE,y.PORTFOLIO_NAME from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR x left join PTL_PORTFOLIO y on x.PORTFOLIO_ID=y.PORTFOLIO_ID where (case when x.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then y.VDATE else to_date('1900-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') end) <=to_date(#{valDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and (case when x.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then y.MDATE else to_date('2099-12-31','yyyy-MM-dd') end) >to_date(#{valDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID and n.IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and n.TIME_POINT !='03'
m.START_DATE <= to_date(#{valDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then to_date('2999-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') else END_DATE end) > to_date(#{valDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and m.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
group by m.PORTFOLIO_ID,m.PORTFOLIO_NAME

select portfolio_id portfolioCode, finprod_id assetCode, nvl(sum(nvl(DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP, 0)),0) amount, sum(share_amt) num from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where cdate = (select max(cdate) from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where cdate < #{valDate, jdbcType=DATE})
and (portfolio_id||':'||finprod_id) in
#{item}
group by portfolio_id,finprod_id
